title: C:contained-swimmers (SIBWMD): active-nematic rods from noise whose self-made surfactant ring drives them by a Marangoni stress, holds a cargo, and passes both to the two daughters after the rod has swum 3-7 body lengths; 6-7 swim-then-divide individuals per seed on 3 seeds, at a true dt/2 and a 1.5x grid; the passive twin is static
summary: world.py is the nematic-cargo world (20261026T0405-c34-nematic-cargo: c11's active-nematic rods, after Giomi and DeSimone PRL 2014, with a surfactant made only on rod pixels and a cargo it excludes) with one back-action of the ring on the rod: a tangential Marangoni stress f = -mar |grad phi| (I - nn) grad s (s lowers the tension; mar=40), so surfactant gradients along a rod's own interface drive flow (cf. Michelin, Lauga and Bartolo 2013 for spontaneous Marangoni/autophoretic propulsion). From uniform noise on seeds 0-2 (T=1000) rods form, divide by binary fission (22/28/26 persistent splits, generation 3/5/4, merge/split 0.32-0.35) and swim at 0.8-0.9 px per frame, four times the mar=0 world (0.2-0.28); 7, 6 and 7 tracks per seed move >= 3 labkit body lengths and then divide (best 7.1, 7.0, 5.4), against 0 on all 3 seeds at mar=0. Every rod carries its ring (100% of body-frames pass rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 by signed distance) and holds its cargo (in/out 10.4-10.8, all body-frames >= 2), and 100% of daughters keep >= 2x five frames after fission; the kappa=0 ablation (same bodies) loses it (in/out 1.33, 0% of daughters). A true dt/2 (4 swim-then-divide tracks, speed 0.8-1.0 px/frame, cargo 10.5) and a 1.5x grid (4 tracks, 0.8 world units per frame, ring 100%, cargo 18.6) hold. The matched passive twin (zeta=0 and mar=0) forms static round droplets with ring and cargo and no division or motion on 2 seeds.

claims.statement: From uniform noise (seeds 0-2), active-nematic rods form and reproduce by binary fission (22/28/26 persistent splits, generation 3/5/4); each carries a surfactant ring it makes itself and holds a cargo inside it; driven by the Marangoni stress of that ring together with its active stress, 6-7 rods per seed swim 3-7 labkit body lengths between birth and fission with the rod shape kept, and both daughters inherit ring and cargo.
claims.track: seed 0, track 25 (strip_ring_seed0_track25.png, strip_cargo_seed0_track25.png): born by fission at frame 49, swims 54.7 px (7.1 labkit body lengths, 3.3 rod lengths) along a smooth curve with its ring and its cargo, divides at frame 78 into tracks 35 and 36, both ringed and holding cargo; the same body with the wall ablated (strip_cargo_kappa0_seed0_track25.png) leaks its cargo

controls_run.B: 20261026T0200-c34-rodsource ablate_chis0 (no adsorption: diffuse fill, 0%); ring 100% here on 3 seeds, dthalf/ and res15/
controls_run.W: ablate_kappa0/ (seed 0, same bodies): cargo in/out 1.33, 5% of body-frames >= 2, 0% of daughters; res15/ 18.6; dthalf/ 10.5; also 20261026T0405-c34-nematic-cargo pack_kappa0 seeds 0-1
controls_run.M: mar=0 (20261026T0405-c34-nematic-cargo/pack seeds 0-2, otherwise the same world): 0 swim-then-divide tracks on 3 seeds, speed 0.2-0.28 px/frame; dthalf/ (true dt/2) and res15/ (1.5x grid) keep 4 tracks each
controls_run.D: twin_passive/ seeds 0-1 (zeta=0, mar=0): 0 splits; dthalf/ 16 persistent splits; res15/ 21

claims.bd_control: twin_passive/ (zeta=0 and mar=0: both non-diffusive stresses off, seeds 0-1): static round droplets with ring and cargo, 0 splits, 0 tracks moving 1 body length, so M and D are beyond diffusion and B and W are not. With zeta=0 and mar=40 (twin_zeta0/, seed 0) the Marangoni stress alone stretches the droplets into long filaments that fragment (8 persistent splits) and then freeze, so the swim-then-divide life needs both stresses.

limitations: The ring is an adsorbed coating: its drift is written against the body field (chis Ds s grad(1-phi^2)), so B rests on the RUBRIC L3 self-made-species clause (source on rod pixels only); here it also does work, since removing its Marangoni stress (mar=0) removes swim-then-divide. The wall acts through an imposed coupling (cargo chemical potential ln c + kappa s), and only about a quarter of all cargo is on rod pixels at a time (the rest has leaked and decays). M: 6-7 of 20-23 dividing tracks per seed pass 3 labkit body lengths (net / sqrt(area)); by rod length (net / major axis) only 2 tracks on seed 0 pass 3, most reach 1.5-3. Tracks of fast rods often curve (persistence < 1). mar=40, kappa=20, chis=5 and the cargo rates were chosen in short seed-0 sweeps (scan.txt in the sighting). The dt/2 run shows a lower maximum speed (0.22 vs 0.39) but the same mean speed. Merge/split 0.32-0.35.
